From Brazil's deepwater potential to Argentina's investment wave and emerging opportunities in Guyana, Suriname and Venezuela, the region is entering a new phase of growth.
Established producers are expanding output, frontier plays continue to attract attention, and regulatory changes are reshaping the investment landscape.
In this video, Wood Mackenzie experts unpack the upstream trends reshaping the region, explore the projects drawing the biggest investment, and examine the commercial and policy forces that will define the next wave of growth.
